title: Farishta
desc: A father's mistaken belief sends his son to prison. Years later, they reunite in their darkest hour, seeking redemption and a second chance.

desc: Lakshmi, a bright bride, tackles the curse plaguing Jhakjhorpur village, where mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law clash, blending humor and drama in a heartwarming tale.

title: Raja Babu
desc: Raj Kumar, a loser, dreams of becoming a wealthy man. His life changes after he participates in a game show and wins a huge prize money.

desc: Dubey shines as a top Bhojpuri actress, thanks to her hit films!

title: Mehandi Laga Ke Rakhna

title: Vijeta
desc: Confused and caught in between the marital problems of his parents, Angad chooses to become a fighter pilot with the Indian Air Force. Will he succeed in life?
